summary: @servicetitan/eh-module-communication preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 728 KB payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs probes PATH for the Bun runtime and, if absent, downloads Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 728 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotating string array via a `WV8StW` shift loop, custom `hc1jfK9` alphabet decoder) that is not referenced by the package's declared main entry `dist/index.js` and bears no relation to the package's stated purpose (a React communication registry). The obfuscated payload is executed under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` scope but the shipped behavior does not match that organization's public libraries.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
